WF-03 Step 5: Test execution for ISS-0187 / GH-521 fix.

Pre-checks (mandatory per TEST-RUNNER section of CLAUDE.md):
1. Backend services: docker-compose ps (db_test, keycloak) - all healthy
2. Infrastructure: zig build migrate exits 0; psql schema_migrations count matches migrations/ count
3. python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration exits 0, no BLOCKER
4. python3 tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests exits 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR
5. python3 tools/verify_test_env.py exits 0 (10/10 checks)

If all pre-checks pass:
- Run `zig build test-integration-exp --summary all` x 5 consecutive times
- Verify: stable result across all 5 runs, no failures (the test-integration-exp target is the EXP suite; the 21-failure baseline applies to test_api08_auth/PD-07 under `zig build test`, not this target)
- Write results to tests/reports/report-2026-08-07-WF03-GH521-20260808.yaml per docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §9

Complete handoff with PASS/FAIL.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration-exp runs 5 times, 13/13 stable
Regression test TC-EXP-202-05 'Pool-size-3 duplicate append (ISS-0187 regression)' passes
Report file at tests/reports/ exists in YAML format

result.summary: All pre-checks pass. zig build test-integration-exp --summary all produced 13/13 PASS on 5 consecutive runs (stable, no failures). The new regression test TC-EXP-202-05 'Pool-size-3 duplicate append (ISS-0187 regression)' is included in the 13 and passes — it forces pool_size=3 and exercises the duplicate-idempotency-key path that previously failed with PoolError.ExhaustedPool on the buggy nested-acquire code. Store.append now reuses the held conn (rolled back at the duplicate-detection branch) for both SELECT lookups, eliminating the nested acquire. test-env-verify passed all 10 checks (C0..C9). test_isolation_lint: 129 files, no isolation issues. lint_sql_param_types: 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR.
